newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: F J Benjamin IPO issue fully subscribed - DBS Bank.
newsitem.headline: F J Benjamin IPO issue fully subscribed - DBS Bank.

text.p: The initial public offer (IPO) of luxury retailer F J Benjamin Holdings Ltd has been fully subscribed, Eric Ang, executive vice president of DBS Bank, said on Friday.
DBS is the co-manager and co-underwriter for the issue.
Ang, who was speaking at the launch of Nobel Design Holdings Ltd's IPO where DBS was also the lead manager, said investor sentiment for IPOs had picked up in recent weeks.
Kian Ann Engineering Ltd, which closed its offer on Thursday, was 30 times subscribed, the highest subscription rate so far this year, he said.
F J Benjamin is offering 50 million shares at Singapore S$0.80 each in its IPO including a placement portion of 10 million shares.
Ang said the public portion of 40 million shares was already fully subcribed while the 10 million placement shares had been taken up earlier.
F J Benjamin's offer closes on November 12.
